title: What Are Liquid Sensory Floor Tiles?
description: BIJOYISM liquid sensory floor tiles are separate, rigid tiles for indoor play, ages 3+. Hand or foot pressure moves the colored liquid pattern. The current Animal Discovery, Color Duos, and Aqua Tones collections each contain eight tiles. Use them on a dry, level floor or carpet with adult supervision.

title: How to Clean and Store Liquid Sensory Tiles
description: BIJOYISM TD01, TD02, and TD03 liquid sensory tiles have splash-resistant surfaces that can be rinsed or wiped with a soft, damp cloth. Do not submerge the tiles or leave them in prolonged contact with water. Wipe them dry or air-dry them in a cool place, then stack them neatly for storage. Check before play and stop using a damaged tile. Use indoors on a dry, level floor with adult supervision.

title: Testing and CPC for TD01, TD02, and TD03
description: The current TD01, TD02, and TD03 collections have a Children’s Product Certificate (CPC) and have been tested for applicable ASTM F963-23 and CPSIA requirements. The documents cover the listed models and applicable test items.

title: 液体感官地垫是什么，三个系列怎么选？
description: BIJOYISM 液体感官地垫是适合 3 岁及以上儿童的独立硬质地垫。手掌按压或脚部踩踏时，彩色液体纹理会移动。当前动物探索、缤纷双色和水漾色彩三个系列均为八片装，适用于室内干燥、平整的地面或地毯，并需成人监护。

title: 液体感官地垫如何清洁、检查和收纳？
description: BIJOYISM TD01、TD02、TD03 液体感官地垫表面防泼溅，可冲洗或用柔软湿布擦拭。请勿浸泡，也不要让地垫长时间接触水。清洁后擦干或在阴凉处晾干，再整齐叠放收纳。使用前检查是否损坏；发现损坏时停止使用。请在成人监护下，于室内干燥、平整的地面使用。

title: TD01、TD02、TD03 的检测与证书依据
description: 当前 TD01、TD02、TD03 三个系列均具备儿童产品证书（CPC），并完成适用的 ASTM F963-23 和 CPSIA 要求检测。文件适用范围以所列型号和检测项目为准。
